source.author: cic
source.text: vestra admurmuratio facit, Quirites, ut agnoscere videamini qui haec fecerint; ego autem nomino neminem; qua re irasci mihi nemo poterit nisi qui ante de se voluerit confiteri.
source.text_original: vestra admurmuratio facit, Quirites, ut agnoscere videamini qui haec fecerint; ego autem nomino neminem; qua re irasci mihi nemo poterit nisi qui ante de se voluerit confiteri.
source.text_english: Your murmur of approval, citizens, makes it seem that you recognize who did these things; but I am naming no one; for this reason, no one will be able to be angry with me except the man who beforehand has wished to confess about himself.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: qui mihi irasci uoluerit, prius ipse de se, quod talis sit, confitetur.
reuse.text_original: qui mihi irasci uoluerit, prius ipse de se, quod talis sit, confitetur.
reuse.text_english: Whoever wishes to be angry with me first confesses about himself that he is such a man.
